text: The only thing that makes life possible is permanent, intolerable uncertainty: not knowing what comes next.
author: Ursula K. Le Guin

text: You cannot buy the revolution. You cannot make the revolution. You can only be the revolution. It is in your spirit, or it is nowhere.
author: Shevek
source: Ursula K. Le Guin, The Dispossessed (1974)

text: To be whole is to be part; true voyage is return.
author: Laia Aseio Odo
source: epitaph in Ursula K. Le Guin, The Dispossessed (1974)

text: Water shapes its course according to the nature of the ground over which it flows.
author: Sun Tzu
source: The Art of War, ch. VI (trans. Lionel Giles)

text: Those who know do not speak. Those who speak do not know.
author: Lao Tzu

text: Part of it is movement, but the other part is practice. And now we can extract these two very powerful words, practice and movement. Now you can get rid of the exercise.
author: Ido Portal
